input.code:
import csv
from datetime import date, timedelta
from collections import Counter

TODAY = date(2026, 11, 2)  # the Monday this plan starts
cards = {r["id"]: r for r in csv.DictReader(open("flashcards.csv"))}
for r in cards.values():
    r["ease"], r["interval_days"] = float(r["ease"]), int(r["interval_days"])
    r["reps"], r["lapses"] = int(r["reps"]), int(r["lapses"])

for g in csv.DictReader(open("review-log.csv")):
    c, q = cards[g["card_id"]], int(g["grade"])
    if q < 3:
        c["reps"], c["interval_days"], c["lapses"] = 0, 1, c["lapses"] + 1
    else:
        c["reps"] += 1
        c["interval_days"] = 1 if c["reps"] == 1 else 6 if c["reps"] == 2 else round(c["interval_days"] * c["ease"])
    c["ease"] = max(1.3, round(c["ease"] + 0.1 - (5 - q) * (0.08 + (5 - q) * 0.02), 2))
    c["due"] = (date.fromisoformat(g["date"]) + timedelta(days=c["interval_days"])).isoformat()

# overdue cards come due today; Sunday is a rest day; at most 15 a day
load = Counter()
for c in sorted(cards.values(), key=lambda c: (c["due"], c["ease"])):
    d = max(date.fromisoformat(c["due"]), TODAY)
    if d < TODAY + timedelta(days=7):
        while d.weekday() == 6 or load[d] >= 15:
            d += timedelta(days=1)
        load[d] += 1
    c["due"] = d.isoformat()

print("due per day:", {d.strftime("%a %d"): n for d, n in sorted(load.items())})
weak = sorted(cards.values(), key=lambda c: (c["ease"], -c["lapses"]))[:5]
print("weakest:", [(c["id"], c["front"][:40], c["ease"], c["lapses"]) for c in weak])
w = csv.DictWriter(open("flashcards-updated.csv", "w", newline=""), fieldnames=["id", "deck", "front", "back", "ease", "interval_days", "reps", "lapses", "due"])
w.writeheader()
w.writerows(cards.values())
print("wrote flashcards-updated.csv:", len(cards), "cards")
